sources.quote: In-game content All card art, UI, writing, and audio are created by our team. AI-assisted tools are used internally for workflow tasks and temporary placeholders only. Non-English text in the game is translated with AI from our English writing. We believe an AI-assisted translation serves players better than English-only, and we improve it as we go. The game does not generate content with AI at runtime. Marketing materials Some cinematic sequences in our store trailer were created or assisted with AI video and image tools. Gameplay footage is captured directly from the game. None of the AI-generated trailer footage appears in the game.

sources.quote: Koin Games has included the following disclosure on Steam: "All card art, UI, writing, and audio are created by our team. AI-assisted tools are used internally for workflow tasks and temporary placeholders only. Non-English text in the game is translated with AI from our English writing. We believe an AI-assisted translation serves players better than English-only, and we improve it as we go. The game does not generate content with AI at runtime." The developers additionally acknowledge using AI-assisted images in some of the cinematic trailers, although they maintain that none of this footage appears in the actual game.
